description: Opens https://dashboard.clerk.com in a browser already signed in as the current user, with no password or sign-in step. Use this before you open any page on dashboard.clerk.com in a browser, and also if you reach its sign-in page. Never type credentials for dashboard.clerk.com. Call it with the path you want (for example /settings), then open the returned URL in the browser right away: it works once and expires in about 1 hour. Do not print or share the URL. The session is read-only in the Dashboard, so it cannot change settings. It opens in the connected workspace and cannot switch to another one.

path.description: Page to open after sign-in, as an absolute path such as /settings. Omit for the app's default page.

task_description.description: Short description of why you need the browser session.

name: create_browser_session
title: Open dashboard.clerk.com signed in
